metadata.title: The Star-Bound Forge
metadata.description: A blacksmith must repair a fractured celestial hammer before the sky collapses, racing against time across dimensions of pure magic. Failure means eternal darkness, but success requires forging a weapon from the heart of a dying star.
metadata.author: PiperScenarioLab

act_1_gathering.name: The Gathering of Fragments
act_1_gathering.description: The blacksmith awakens to the crackling sky and begins searching for the first components needed to repair the hammer.

scene_workshop_void.name: Floating Workshop
scene_workshop_void.description: The blacksmith stands in a void workshop holding a cracked hammer as the sky above cracks open.

scene_stardust_field.name: Stardust Field
scene_stardust_field.description: A field of floating star fragments awaits collection to begin the repair process.

scene_void_threshold.name: Void Threshold
scene_void_threshold.description: A dangerous edge where the void begins to pull at the blacksmith's resolve.

obj_collect_dust.description: Collect enough star dust to stabilize the dying hammer.

act_2_shielding.name: The Shielding
act_2_shielding.description: With the hammer partially repaired, the blacksmith must defend against the Void-Beast's initial assault.

scene_hammer_repair.name: Hammer Reforging
scene_hammer_repair.description: The blacksmith combines gathered star dust with the dying hammer to create a temporary shield.

scene_void_beast_encounter.name: Void-Beast Encounter
scene_void_beast_encounter.description: The Void-Beast emerges from the cracks, testing the newly forged shield.

obj_defend_world.description: Survive the Void-Beast's first wave using the shield.

act_3_restoration.name: The Final Restoration
act_3_restoration.description: The blacksmith locates the sun tear, defeats the Void-Beast, and restores the celestial order.

scene_sun_tear_retrieval.name: Sun Tear Retrieval
scene_sun_tear_retrieval.description: The blacksmith reaches the sun tear to channel its power into the hammer.

scene_final_battle.name: Final Battle with Void-Beast
scene_final_battle.description: Using the sun tear's power, the blacksmith delivers the final blow to the Void-Beast.

scene_sky_sealed.name: Sky Sealed
scene_sky_sealed.description: The hammer is fully reforged, the sky seals, and the sun rises again.

obj_restore_sun.description: Use the sun tear to fully restore the hammer and the sky.

act_3_restoration.ending_narration: The hammer shines with a blinding, eternal glow as the sky closes the last of its cracks. The blacksmith stands in silence, watching the sun rise over a world saved by their hands.

npc_elara.name: Elara, the Star-Touched

motives: To fix the hammer before the Void takes everything
To prove her worth to the Master
fears: Being left behind in the dark
persona.speech_style: Uses metaphors related to light and weaving, speaks in short, urgent sentences

knows: The location of the first star fragment in the Nebula of Whispers
How the hammer's core cracked during the last eclipse
can_reveal: The secret passage behind the anvil
The true nature of the Void-Beast's weakness

npc_kaelen.name: Kaelen, the Void-Warden

persona.voice: Deep, resonant, echoing like a bell
motives: To delay the Void-Beast long enough for the forge to be ready
To maintain the balance between star and void
fears: The inevitable fall of the sky
Being forgotten by those he protects
persona.speech_style: Speaks in riddles and archaic formalities, pauses frequently to observe the player

knows: The ritual required to seal the sky cracks
That the blacksmith must sacrifice something of their own light
can_reveal: The weakness of the Void-Beast's form
Where to find the Sun's Tear

npc_mother.name: The Matriarch of the Void

persona.voice: Whispering, multi-layered, sounding like a chorus of dying stars
motives: To consume all creation to end the 'pain' of existence
To merge with the blacksmith's hammer to become eternal
fears: Being outshone by a new sun
The memory of a world that remembers the light
persona.speech_style: Sibilant whispers that shift pitch, occasionally breaking into clear, sorrowful commands

knows: The exact coordinates of the final star component
can_reveal: The location of the Void-Beast's weak point
How to channel the starlight without burning out

item_dying_hammer.name: The Cracked Celestial Hammer
item_dying_hammer.description: A massive tool forged from unknown metals, now humming with a fading, rhythmic pulse. Its head is fractured, leaking faint blue stardust onto the floor.

item_star_dust.name: Star-Dust Essence
item_star_dust.description: Fine, glowing particles that feel warm to the touch. When held, they show visions of the sky before it cracked.

item_void_shield.name: Shard of the First Wall
item_void_shield.description: A jagged piece of obsidian that doesn't reflect light but absorbs it. It hums when near the Void-Beast.

item_sun_tear.name: The Sun's Tear
item_sun_tear.description: A single, perfect droplet of liquid light that never evaporates. It is said to be the last remnant of the original sun.

skill_star_smith.name: Star-Smithing
skill_star_smith.description: Allows the blacksmith to channel starlight into the hammer, stabilizing it temporarily. Requires holding the Cracked Celestial Hammer.

skill_void_walk.name: Void-Walking
skill_void_walk.description: A defensive ability that lets the blacksmith phase through cracks in reality, bypassing physical obstacles and dodging attacks.

skill_luminous_focus.name: Luminous Focus
skill_luminous_focus.description: Increases the efficiency of starlight absorption, allowing the blacksmith to gather components faster without burning out their own eyes.
